title: Vertical Screenshot Grid
description: Turns the crosshair into a 9:16 3x3 grid
body:
![HUD with a crosshair changed to 3x3 grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c146a1028685b4638b665d5a6d790d1f02b52c1.jpeg)
Changes the crosshair to vertical 3x3 grid to take screenshots that are gonna be cropped to 9:16 aspect ratio.
